text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai, and Air
Groove's
long-anticipated race against
Silence Suzuka, has
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Except Silence Suzuka—the opponent
we were
aiming to beat, is absent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka isn't here... but that doesn't
mean I won't
give this race my all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must put my heart and soul into today's

challenge—and emerge readier than
ever to face
Suzuka when the
opportunity does arise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For now... I will show everyone a race
worthy of
the Empress.
